name: Mizan-Tepi University
location: Split across Mizan Teferi and Tepi
distanceNote: A long southwestern trip toward the Bench Sheko and Sheka areas.
campuses: Two campuses, one in Mizan Teferi and one in Tepi, which one you belong to depends on your program.
knownFor: Operating as a genuine two campus system in a remote southwestern corner of the country
Agriculture and natural resource programs suited to the region's forest edge environment
A warmer, more humid climate than almost anywhere else on this list
whatToExpect: The climate here is genuinely different from highland Ethiopia, humid, warm, closer to rainforest edge conditions, students from cooler regions describe a real adjustment period.

Because the university operates across two separate towns, your actual daily experience depends heavily on which campus your program is based at, ask specifically and do not assume Mizan and Tepi offer the same experience.
This is one of the more remote placements on this list, plan supplies, travel, and communication with family around real distance and limited transport frequency.
Insects and general humidity related discomfort are a more constant daily factor here than in the highlands, students who prepare for this adjust faster than those caught off guard.
tips: Confirm which specific campus, Mizan or Tepi, your department is based at before you travel or pack.
Bring genuine mosquito protection, this is a real and regular need in this climate, not an occasional precaution.
studentFit: Mizan-Tepi suits students genuinely open to a remote, humid, forest edge environment and comfortable navigating a two campus system. It fits people drawn to agriculture and natural resource fields specific to this ecological zone. Students who need to stay closer to Addis, who struggle with humidity and insects, or who want a single unified campus should think carefully about this placement.
strengths: Operating as a genuine two campus system in a remote southwestern corner of the country
Agriculture and natural resource programs suited to the region's forest edge environment
A warmer, more humid climate than almost anywhere else on this list
